auth.deviceKey.workdRefused: This Mac's work host didn't accept the request. Try again.

auth.devAccessCommand.unavailable: Couldn't verify the server address, so there are no setup snippets to show. Reopen the app and try again.
auth.devAccessCommand.readIntoEnv: Put the copied value into the environment variable {env}. It's taken as input, not as part of a command, so it stays out of your terminal history.
auth.devAccessCommand.pasteAndEnter: Paste it and press Enter. What you type isn't shown on screen. This works in bash and zsh.
auth.devAccessCommand.environmentCaveat: Environment variables are passed to other programs you run in this terminal. Close the terminal when you're done.
auth.devAccessCommand.stdioLogin: Save the value once in the oort command-line tool. It's taken as input only, and no config file holds it.
auth.devAccessCommand.helperLogin: Save the value once in the oort command-line tool. It's taken as input only.
auth.devAccessCommand.helperClaude: In your project folder's {path}, set {command} as the header helper.
auth.devAccessCommand.helperCodex: In {path}, set {command} as the header helper.
auth.devAccessCommand.helperCli: {command} supplies the value each time. It's handed to curl through its config, so the value never appears in the command arguments.
auth.devAccessCommand.envClaude: Put the content below in your project folder's {path}. The file holds no value, but it does contain the server address, so don't commit it to a repository.
auth.devAccessCommand.envClaudeRun: Run Claude Code from the same terminal where you entered the value.
auth.devAccessCommand.envCodex: Add the content below to {path}. The file holds no value, but it does contain the server address, so don't commit it to a repository.
auth.devAccessCommand.envCodexRun: Run Codex from the same terminal where you entered the value.
auth.devAccessCommand.envCli: The command below hands the value to curl through its config instead of putting it in the arguments, so it doesn't show up in the process list either.
auth.devAccessCommand.envCliDone: If the response shows this connection's name and scope, it's connected.
auth.devAccessCreate.expiryHint: The connection ends on its own once it expires. Once created, the scope, channels and expiry can't be changed. To change them, create a new one and remove the old one.
